target.title: test(shared): add unit tests for agent liveness state helpers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The agent liveness state utilities in `src/shared/agent-liveness.ts` have no dedicated unit tests, leaving the blocked/abandoned state detection and error formatting unverified.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds comprehensive unit test coverage for all five exports:

- `isBlockedLivenessState` — case-insensitive, whitespace-tolerant blocked detection
- `isAbandonedLivenessState` — abandoned state detection
- `formatBlockedLivenessError` — string passthrough + default message fallback
- `formatAbandonedLivenessError` — string passthrough + default message fallback
- `normalizeBlockedLivenessWaitStatus` — status coercion, error preservation

## User Impact

- Purely additive: one new test file, no production code changes
- No risk of breaking existing behavior

## Evidence

```
$ npx vitest run src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isBlockedLivenessState > returns true for "blocked"
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isBlockedLivenessState > returns true for "BLOCKED" (case-insensitive)
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isBlockedLivenessState > returns true with surrounding whitespace
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isBlockedLivenessState > returns false for non-string values
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isBlockedLivenessState > returns false for other states
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isAbandonedLivenessState > returns true for "abandoned"
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > isAbandonedLivenessState > returns false for non-string values
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > formatBlockedLivenessError > returns the trimmed error string
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > formatBlockedLivenessError > returns a default message when error is not a string
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > formatAbandonedLivenessError > returns the trimmed error string
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > formatAbandonedLivenessError > returns a default message when error is not a string
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > normalizeBlockedLivenessWaitStatus > returns original status when livenessState is not blocked
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > normalizeBlockedLivenessWaitStatus > coerces status to error when livenessState is blocked
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > normalizeBlockedLivenessWaitStatus > preserves error when status is already error
 ✓  unit-fast  src/shared/agent-liveness.test.ts > normalizeBlockedLivenessWaitStatus > passes error through when livenessState is blocked

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  15 passed (15)
```
